feeds.title: Mitsueki » Movie Reviews
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Mitsuki, aka Daphy! This blog started on 19 November 2012 and is where I pen and share my random bits of musings, thoughts, ideas, and rants on a huge variety of lifestyle topics such as food, my travels, my life, work matters, sometimes finance and so much more every single day! I write my views on various movies and I can assure you that you would love reading them.

feeds.title: Campus Magazine » Entertainment
feeds.description: Campus Magazine is a Singapore-based media for youths! We are rich in student-oriented content, but we are not a student-run media. However, we do have dozens of student contributors submitting articles on an array of topics from education to lifestyle, and local happenings, so we stay relevant to our audience. You will also find a lot of fun stuff in the entertainment section like articles, podcasts, etc.

feeds.title: Singapore Film Locations
feeds.description: Singapore Film Locations Archive showcases screen memories of Singapore and chronicles the historical transformation of Singapore's urban and rural landscapes through 'on-location' scenes in films produced and released in the 20th century. It aims to be a definitive online resource and database for information on the history of film location shooting in Singapore.

feeds.title: Shopee Blog » Movie Night
feeds.description: Your go-to space for curated food guides, the latest fashion and beauty trends, tech tips, home hacks to make your life easier, parenting ideas, and more. Discover the latest trends, awesome Shopee promos, must-try tips and tricks, and product reviews! In the movie night section, read about how to plan a perfect movie night, how to pick movies and more.

feeds.title: Sinema
feeds.description: Singapore & Asian Film News Portal since 2006. Sinema Media is a consultancy and project management company focusing on film and media initiatives. Their aim is to promote and advocate for the creation and consumption of Singaporean stories both locally and internationally.

feeds.title: Intuitive Films Blog
feeds.description: Singapore Video Production House with 15 years of experience creating commercials & corporate videos. We're a full-service video production company and creative content agency based in Singapore, founded in 2007 and trusted by top brands, global companies & government agencies.

feeds.title: Film Based Traveler Blog
feeds.description: I started this blog in 2016 with the goal to travel the world (hopefully full-time) with a film camera. In short, Film Based Traveler is my blog to share my combined interest in travel and photography. Currently, I blog mainly about film photography, the technique I learned, and showcasing film samples at FILM LOOK so readers can grasp its look.

feeds.title: Asian Film Archive
feeds.description: The Asian Film Archive was founded in January 2005 as a non-profit organization to preserve the rich film heritage of Singapore and Asian Cinema, to encourage scholarly research on film, and to promote a wider critical appreciation of this art form. Their mission is to save, explore and share the art of Asian Cinema. Aside from housing the gems of the Asian cinematic world, they also function as vibrant hubs of activity.

feeds.title: Augustman Singapore
feeds.description: Augustman's print edition was launched in 2006, followed by the digital platform in 2009. This is a lifestyle platform tailored to modern gentlemen aged between 25 to 45. Keeping an eye on international trends, the site offers localized content spanning fashion, gear, grooming, wellness, and culture. Style, substance, and success form the brand's ethos.

feeds.title: Singapore Film Society Blog
feeds.description: With over 6 decades of experience as a non-profit organization, we have amassed a highly skilled and diverse team of professionals, both in career and in attitude. We're bringing the best of cinema to you, with you. We envision a society where everyone has equal exposure to meaningful and necessary films, and a platform to share their voices and opinions.
